name: Elasticsearch
summary: Index Ogun run and approval events and metrics into Elasticsearch with the _bulk API, on Elastic Cloud or a self-managed cluster.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key (encoded)
fields.help: The encoded value, sent as Authorization: ApiKey. Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Elasticsearch host
settings.help: Host only. Elastic Cloud shows it as the deployment's Elasticsearch endpoint.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: 443 on Elastic Cloud; 9200 on a self-managed node.

notes: Metrics, indexed as documents: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
